active.policy: Built, tested, budgeted, and eligible for the governed release artifact.

compat.policy: Preserve wire, symbol, JSON, hash, and operator compatibility without granting production authority.
invariants: compatibility handlers are never proof of production ingress
legacy Control UI POST routes remain plan-only
generated compatibility payloads retain their decoded SHA-256 identities

archive.policy: Never merge archived history back into main; preserve it in a verified bundle before pruning refs.
restore_contract: record every archived ref and object ID
fetch the bundle into an empty bare repository
compare every restored ref and object ID before deleting source refs
